issue_context.title: Rainmachine integration fails when adding the device.
issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/releases
  - Do not report issues for integrations if you are using custom components or integrations.
  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened instead.
-->

Attempting to add the Rainmachine integration from the UI results in an error in `home-assistant.log`. It then adds the integration without any associated entities. The UI believes it was successful although the log indicates that it failed. 

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant release with the issue: 0.107.0
- Last working Home Assistant release (if known): 0.106.6
- Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.): Hass.io on Ubuntu
- Integration causing this issue: Rainmachine
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/rainmachine/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

It's just the values from the integration UI:
```yaml
hostname: 
password: 
port:
```

Nothing special here, the UI only asks for a few options when you add the integration.  

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
2020-03-18 14:06:30 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.config_entries] Error setting up entry rainmachine.naternet.local for rainmachine
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/config_entries.py", line 216, in async_setup
    hass, self
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/rainmachine/__init__.py", line 146, in async_setup_entry
    ssl=config_entry.data[CONF_SSL],
KeyError: 'ssl'
```

## Additional information
This was working prior to 1.107.0
comments: Hey there @bachya, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`rainmachine`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L294) for? Thanks!

review_comments: Why are you no longer removing the config entry? that seems wrong.
